# A diagnostic probe whose new run differs reports 'changed recorded=<class>';
# the correctness-essential classes are asserted by the probes themselves.

client probe RL: PASS class=RL-none
client probe RET: PASS class=RET-ok
client probe R19: PASS class=R19-closed
# R19: the compiled PreModelSwitch hook carries onFailure "block": a missing,
# non-executable, crashing or timed-out shim keeps the lead (without it the
# first three switch); deny and allow answers are unchanged. A shim exiting 0
# with a non-JSON answer gives no decision and the switch proceeds (the real
# shim answers its own deny on every failure).
client probe SK: PASS class=SK-kept
client probe OC: PASS class=OC-untouched
client probe FL: PASS class=FL-ok
client probe CC: PASS class=CC-bash-child

# FD: notify restores the lead; the subagent notify control is unavailable.
client probe XC: PASS class=XC-exact
client probe DG: PASS class=DG-resumable
# DG: 2.1.302 tool turn + /compact resumes on 2.1.292 with summary only.
client probe SL: BOUNDARY class=unavailable

# Supervisor takeover and staged marketplace-plugin updates remain INCONCLUSIVE
# offline. Signed real-provider behavior is not established by these fixtures.

# The receipts below: signed client 2.1.302 linux-x64 (binary sha256
# 60d7eb7f12fbb28a52533fe8be5884097403562aa02dc73991a021c7067e29a5, release
# manifest sha256 d7d4f193bfebb48733027b0dc43d6996d99f5335d152961a729730e55bbd5aa1),
# 2026-10-19.

# The session window's representation (tests/test_compaction_window_probe.py),
# session window 800000 at 90 %:
compaction window probe: PASS class=env-window-holds
# The compiled window variable: the lead compacts at 702000 fresh, on
# --resume, against user, project and local top-level, per-model and env
# values of 300000 and a process env of 300000, after /autocompact 300000
# (which saves nothing under the variable) and with a native --autocompact
# 1000000 (a launch refuses the flag; the variable outranks it anyway); a
# 128000-bound agent shares its 200K class's window (162000). A lead set bound
# at 80000 compacts at the client's 100K floor (67000; charmer compiles and
# shows 47000), never at the model's own default.
# Per-agent windows are not compiled: under the variable a 128000 agent
# window is ignored (162000). Recorded, never gating: a top-level
# autoCompactWindow with the variable "0" in the flag-settings env lowers an
# agent to its own window (95000 for 128000, 252000 for 300000 on a 1M agent;
# one above the class or below 100K is ignored) and holds the lead against the
# same user layers, /autocompact, --resume and --agent, but a native
# --autocompact 1000000 replaces it (no compaction by 800000) and an 80000
# lead set falls back to the model's own window (no compaction by 180000). Its
# survival of a supervisor takeover, a same-process /autocompact and a
# workflow agent's window are not measured offline, so it is not compiled.
# --autocompact as the representation passes the lead, user-layer and agent
# cases; /autocompact in a running session replaces it (read from the build).
#
# The fence's cold start (protocol-3 shim plus a launcher answering premodel,
# 300 runs each, bytecode warm, 16 CPUs): CPython 3.14.6 p99 0.13 / 0.26 /
# 0.43 / 2.57 s at 0, 16, 32 and 64 CPU burners (max 3.33 s); CPython 3.15.0
# p99 0.17 / 0.45 / 1.75 / 3.47 s (max 4.31 s). Its budget is 15 s.
